# @audinue/ooui

> TypeScript/Bun port of [Ooui](https://github.com/praeclarum/ooui): define your
> UI as a server-side tree of `Element` objects, and Ooui keeps a real browser
> DOM in sync with it over a WebSocket. All state and logic live on the
> server; the browser runs only a small (~250-line) client that applies patch
> messages and reports events back. No virtual DOM, no client build step, no
> client-side framework.

Requires the [Bun](https://bun.sh) runtime — the server uses `Bun.serve`,
`Bun.build`, `Bun.file`, and `Bun.CryptoHasher` directly and has no Node.js
fallback. Only the core element model was ported from the original C#
project; `Ooui.Forms` (Xamarin.Forms) and `Ooui.Wasm` (Mono/WebAssembly) were
intentionally left out — they have no TypeScript/browser equivalent.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): install, quick-start example, and the
  publish-a-shared-vs-per-tab-element distinction.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): architecture (message protocol, session/throttling
  model, circular-import workarounds), directory layout, and the reasoning
  behind the three separate tsconfigs and the build step.

## API surface

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): the full public export list — core classes
  (`EventTarget`, `Node`, `Element`, `Document`, `Window`, `Body`, `Style`,
  `Message`), HTML elements (`Div`, `Span`, `Paragraph`, `Heading`, `Anchor`,
  `Label`, `Image`, `List`, `ListItem`, `Form`, `FormControl`, `Button`,
  `Input`, `TextArea`, `Select`, `Option`, `TextNode`), and the server API
  (`UI.publish`, `UI.start`, `Session`, `WebSocketSession`).
- [src/core/Message.ts](src/core/Message.ts): the wire protocol — every
  server → client mutation and client → server event is one of `create`,
  `set`, `setAttr`, `remAttr`, `call`, `listen`, `event`.
- [src/server/UI.ts](src/server/UI.ts): `UI.publish(path, elementOrCtor)` to
  register a route, `UI.start()` to boot the Bun websocket server.

## Examples

- [examples/app.ts](examples/app.ts): a runnable app with two samples — a
  shared click counter and a shared todo list — plus an index page. Run with
  `bun run example`.
- [tests/e2e.test.ts](tests/e2e.test.ts): headless-browser tests
  (bun:test + playwright) that exercise the same samples end-to-end and
  double as protocol usage examples (add/remove children, toggle styles,
  read back DOM state after a server-side mutation).

## Optional

- [package.json](package.json): scripts (`build`, `test`, `typecheck`,
  `format`, `example`) and the npm `exports`/`files` shape.
- [../ooui-main](../ooui-main) (sibling directory, not part of this package):
  the original C# Ooui source this port mirrors class-for-class and
  message-for-message.
